On Sunday, the first match at the city’s tennis open ended with an unexpected result. Pablo Andújar from Spain won against Dominic Thiem of Austria. Many thought Thiem would go on to the next round. The match lasted more than two hours. Both players were focused. Andújar started strong and took the first set 6-4. Thiem tried to come back in the second set but could not win crucial games. Andújar kept steady and won the second set 7-5.

Fans were surprised. Thiem was a favorite for the open. He had won important titles in the past years. His return to the court was awaited by supporters. After a long injury, everyone was hoping to see his best level. But on this Sunday, his game was not enough. His backhand shots missed often. He also made mistakes near the net.

Andújar said it was a hard match. He respected Thiem and knew the game would be close. He stayed confident after losing a few games in the second set. He said he trusted his serve and tried to keep putting pressure on Thiem. Andújar also said the stadium noise gave him extra energy.

Thiem told journalists he was disappointed. He said his form was not perfect yet. He promised to practice more and come back stronger. He thanked the audience for support, even when he was behind. Thiem said he would learn from the loss and not give up.

On the same day, two more games happened. Local players received loud cheers, but only one went on to the next round. Organizers reported happy crowds, even with rain during the afternoon. They said ticket sales increased compared to last year.

The next matches will continue on Monday. Players from different countries will fight for a place in the finals. For Andújar, the win gives him hope to go further. For Thiem, the tournament is over, but many think he can return to his best soon. The open continues with more surprise results possible. The fans look forward to seeing who will become champion.

On Monday, many people gathered at the community hall in central Honolulu. There was excitement and also worry. The Hawaii State Language Committee met to talk about HSL. Hawaii Sign Language, or HSL, has a long but quiet history. Few people know about this language. Many think that American Sign Language is the only way for deaf people to communicate. But in Hawaii, this is not the full truth.

Kaleo Lambrecht, who is 52, spoke to the group. He used HSL with strong movements. His mother, Lani Lambrecht, explained with her voice. “My son always used HSL at home. He learned it from my father, who was born in 1920. We did not know about American Sign Language. Only HSL,” she said.

Many deaf people in Hawaii share this story. Their families learned HSL many years ago, before ASL was brought to the schools. HSL is different from ASL. Some words look the same, but much is not the same. People say it is its own language.

Scholars from the University of Hawaii started to study HSL in 2011. Dr. James Green, a linguist, shared findings at the meeting. He said, “We have found that HSL is unique. It has its own grammar and signs. It is not the same as ASL. HSL came from the deaf community in Hawaii. It is a local creation. But now, fewer than 30 people use it fluently.”

Many who use HSL are old. Young people do not learn it. At the Hawaii School for the Deaf and Blind in Honolulu, teachers use American Sign Language. This is the national norm. Students there may hear about HSL, but they learn standard ASL.

Eileen Kamaka, who grew up deaf on Kauai, remembers her first time at this school. “I was 8 years old when I came to Honolulu. My home signs were HSL. But at school, all the teachers signed ASL. Other children already knew ASL. I felt lost."

Others had the same feeling. Some teachers told students that HSL was wrong. They said it was an old way and not correct. “This made many children ashamed of HSL,” says Lani Lambrecht. “They stopped using it. They did not teach it to their children.”

Now, people are trying to save HSL. The committee asks the state to help. They want classes in HSL, books, and videos. Some ask for HSL to be taught alongside ASL at the deaf school. There is hope that young deaf children could learn both.

The state has promised to look at the issue. Thomas Okana, who works for the Department of Education, said, “We know about the problem. We want to respect Hawaii’s history. But we must think how to add HSL. We have few teachers for HSL. Also, we must talk with families. Many parents only know ASL.”

Parents are worried about confusion. Some ask if students will become mixed up with two sign languages. Dr. Green says this will not be a big problem. “Children in many countries learn more than one language,” he says. “They are smart. They understand when to use which language. HSL is important for Hawaiian culture.”

The committee also wants recognition of HSL as an official state language. Some say this will help the language to survive. It would make Hawaii the first state in the US with two official sign languages.

But not all agree. Some school leaders say resources are too few. They say schools already struggle. “We need more teachers. We need updated materials. Adding a second sign language is not easy,” says Rachel Lee, principal of the deaf school.

Parents of young deaf children want strong support for ASL. They say it helps children to join in the wider world. “My son can use ASL to speak with deaf people everywhere in America,” says Ana Souza, whose child is six. “HSL is interesting, but he needs ASL to have more choices.”

But for the Lambrecht family, this is about more than school. “HSL is like Hawaiian language. It is ours,” says Lani. Her son, Kaleo, adds with his hands, “My grandfather’s hands told stories. If nobody learns HSL, those stories become lost.”

The committee is working with the university. They record the stories of older HSL users. They take videos and make sign dictionaries. They hope this will help future children learn.

Some efforts happen at home. Aunty Malia, who is 80 and deaf, teaches her grandchildren signs. “I use HSL with them when they visit me. They laugh and copy me. I think they remember,” she says with a smile.

World scientists have discovered a new change in the reefs of the ocean. The research was released on Thursday in the city of Canberra. The study took place in different seas and focused on reefs. They found something special about sharks near these places. Experts believe the number of shark species is dropping in many parts of the world. Some species are disappearing from the well-known coral reefs. This is because water temperatures are warming. Scientists think climate change is the main reason for this.

The team has been observing the reefs for several years. During this time, many coral structures started to lose color. This is called bleaching. It happens when the water gets too hot for a long time. Without healthy coral, small fish and other creatures cannot stay. Sharks also leave. In some reefs, researchers noticed only one or two types of sharks remained. In the past, those areas had many more species.

This finding is worrying for marine experts. They say if this situation continues, the balance in the ocean could change. Sharks are important for healthy reefs. When there are fewer sharks, other fish numbers grow too fast. This can hurt the reef even more. Some experts call sharks the ‘guardians’ of the reef. If they go away, the coral is in more danger.

Besides temperature, scientists found other problems. Fishing is also affecting shark numbers. Even when fishing is not allowed near reefs, illegal boats come at night. They catch sharks for their fins or meat. Sometimes, sharks get trapped by accident in nets meant for other fish. The team says stronger rules may be needed. They also want people to learn about why sharks are important for the ocean.

The report also describes how weather is becoming less predictable. Storms are more powerful. When strong waves hit a reef, it can break the coral. After the damage, it is hard for new coral to grow. Small animals have trouble surviving. Sharks must travel farther to find food. Young sharks are especially at risk. They need safe places with lots of fish.

The research group used underwater cameras and special sensors. They spent many months gathering information. The team leader, Dr. Sarah Lin, said they saw big changes from year to year. She explained that in 2010, they could see up to ten shark species in one part of the reef. In 2023, only three or four were there. This makes it harder for the reef to recover after disasters like bleaching or storms.

Some local people are also worried. In the Pacific, islanders have seen fewer sharks near their homes. They say the ocean feels empty. Fishers catch less now. Tourism is suffering too. Visitors come to see healthy coral and big fish like sharks. If these disappear, there are fewer jobs for local families.

The authors of the study say solving these problems is not easy. The oceans are connected. Changes in one place can affect others far away. They advise working together, across countries, to protect reefs and sharks. They ask for governments to make new agreements and spend money on ocean science. They also suggest teaching children about the ocean. Dr. Lin is hopeful people will listen. If action comes soon, she believes reefs and sharks can recover.

Experts agree this is a warning for the world. Coral reefs help protect coasts from storms. They give homes to thousands of creatures. They are important for food and jobs. The loss of sharks shows reefs are in trouble. Scientists say everyone must care for the ocean, before it is too late.

A recently published report has caused much discussion in the country. The report, which was revealed on Thursday by the Commission for Inquiry, contains many pages about the homes for children and mothers that were run by various organizations during the last century. According to the report, more than 10,000 children and mothers passed through these homes. Many of them did not leave with good memories. Some did not survive at all. The commission said survivors told of harsh conditions, hunger, and sadness. Many suffered as babies.

The report stated that, in some homes, the mothers were separated from their babies very soon after birth. In some cases, no contact was allowed, so mothers could not see or hold their newborns. Some mothers reported being told nothing about where their children had gone. Some later discovered their child had died. Survivors spoke about feelings of loss that lasted for decades. The commission pointed to many failings by those who ran the homes and those who were supposed to check on them.

Among the findings in the report, the commission said that very young children and babies were often underfed. Many former residents described being always hungry. Meals were small and lacked variety. Some survivors said food was sometimes spoiled, or little was given to babies. The report said that this did not seem to be due to lack of money. Sometimes the homes received enough public funds for better care. The commission said the staff at the homes were often unkind, and sometimes cruel. Punishment was common, both for mothers and children. Some women told the commission they were forced to do hard work while recovering from childbirth. Some children described being made to clean large areas, or carry heavy buckets, when they were only five or six years old.

A significant part of the report concentrates on how children, especially babies, were adopted or fostered out from the homes. In many cases, adoption happened without the mother’s agreement. The commission said that records were badly kept. It is not possible to know for sure how many children disappeared from the records. Some survivors said they came searching for their birth mothers or siblings years later and found nothing but silence. A small number of people told the commission they discovered by accident that they had spent their first years in one of the homes. Their adoptive parents had not been told the real story.

The commission gathered information by interviewing over four hundred former residents of the homes, both mothers and people who had lived there as children. The interviews lasted several months. Many survivors spoke for the first time about their experiences. During the hearings, some women broke down in tears because the memories were too painful. The commission thanked them for their courage. Some people expressed anger, saying they lost their childhood to the system. The report contains direct quotations from survivors. One woman said, “We were never allowed to hold our babies. I remember the sound of them crying.” Another said, “They punished me for asking about my child. They said I should forget her.”

The government replied to the report with an official statement. The statement said that the findings were disturbing. The government offered apologies for the suffering caused. It promised to set up a special fund to help survivors. The fund will be used to provide counseling, support, and help with searching for information. The government also said it will consider changing the law so that all records are made easier to access. Survivors welcomed the apology but said that practical help was needed, not just words.

One particular part of the report has received much attention. The commission found that, in some homes, babies who died were not given proper burials. Records of deaths were often not written down. In some cases, the graves of infants were left unmarked. The commission said that mothers were rarely told what happened to their babies if there was a death. Other children who lived in the homes remember being told not to ask questions. Some survivors said that, as adults, they spent years searching for the graves of siblings or their own children with no answers. The commission described this practice as deeply upsetting and against basic respect for families.

The report also describes the living conditions inside the homes. Many survivors said that the buildings were cold and damp. Heating was poor. Some people remember sharing beds with many others. Privacy was not allowed. Mothers were watched at all times, even when feeding their babies. Several survivors said that children were sometimes left alone in rooms for long hours as a punishment. Hurricane Doriana, which has been moving through the Atlantic since the end of August, hit the northern Bahamas islands with strong force during the first week of September. The first warnings were sent out by meteorologists early on August 28, when the storm became stronger. By the start of September, it had grown into a dangerous Category 5 system. Citizens in the islands prepared for the winds and rain, but some were still surprised by the strength of both. On September 2, towns in Abaco and Grand Bahama faced winds up to 290 kilometers per hour. Houses lost roofs. In many places, the water reached the second stories.

People started sharing photos online. There were images of empty homes, with windows blown out. Many photos showed streets now under water. Boats that used to float in the sea now sat stuck between buildings. The captions that people wrote for these photos said the same thing: this hurricane changed everything. Some pictures from August showed the islands before the hurricane. Blue sky, palm trees, children laughing by the water. Photos taken after Doriana arrived showed a very different world. In one, a man stands in waist-high water, carrying his daughter. In another, a group waits on a rooftop for help, trying to wave to a passing helicopter.

Rescue workers came from other islands and countries to help. They brought food, water, and blankets. The wind still blew hard as they arrived. It was difficult to land boats or helicopters. Some workers had to wait for hours before it was safe. When the wind slowed, teams started to check every house. They called out, knocked on doors, and looked for people or animals left behind. Many families lost contact with their relatives during the storm. Mobile phone service was broken for two days. People used radios to ask for news.

The government in Nassau said at least sixty people were missing by September 5. The number was expected to rise. Photos from weather agencies showed the storm cloud stretching far across the water. Caption writers explained the science: warm water made Doriana bigger and more powerful. Local leaders said it was the worst hurricane since records began. They said the islands will take years to recover. Officials compared before-and-after images and explained how so many houses were now gone. The wind flattened wooden homes in minutes. Brick homes stood longer, but many lost windows and walls. School classrooms filled with debris. Hospital staff worked almost without rest. They had to treat many people for cuts and broken bones.

International aid groups started to fly supplies in. United Nations teams gave out bottled water, crackers, and tarpaulins. Doctors Without Borders set up tents and treated those with fever or wounds. Volunteers shared more photos for the world to see. One photo’s caption described the silence after the hurricane, broken only by helicopters. Animals wandered the ruined neighborhoods, hungry and afraid. Survivors slept outside, waiting for help or news. In the evenings, families gathered by candles and shared stories of what happened when the wind came.

Many people wondered why the hurricane stayed over the islands for almost 24 hours. Meteorologists said Doriana moved very slowly, which made the flooding worse. One man swam through wind and rain to reach his neighbor, who could not walk. He brought them food wrapped in plastic. On social media, supporters share photos from matches and write messages of hope.

In Britain, people still speak about new photos of the royal family. These photos appeared online last weekend. Many people shared them. The pictures show Prince William, his wife Catherine, and their daughter Princess Charlotte. The family is seen in a garden close to their home. The weather looks cloudy. They are dressed in simple clothes.

The pictures have received many comments. People are talking about different things. Some people say Princess Charlotte looks older. Others discuss why Prince George and Prince Louis are not in the photos. Many say it is a surprise. Usually, pictures of the royal family include all the children.

A strange thing is how the photos are labeled. Under each photo, the caption says “With love from us.” The use of “us” is not explained. Some people on social media ask about this. They write that the caption is confusing. Some say they want a more formal message. Others say the family tries to look more normal.

Another topic is the place where the photos are taken. The background looks like a small park or garden. British gardens are important for royal families. Many events happen there. Some people wrote that the garden is probably behind their house. Others think it is a public park. A few say the garden is not familiar.

Royal family watchers give opinions about Catherine. She holds Princess Charlotte’s hand in one image. In another, she stands a little behind her husband and daughter. People comment on her health. She wears a light jacket. Some say she looks tired. Others say she smiles, but it is not her usual smile. This has caused rumors. Some think something is wrong.

Prince William is in all the photos. He smiles in each picture. His hair looks more gray than before. He wears jeans and a blue shirt. Some say he looks more relaxed. Others believe he tries to hide stress. There are many ideas about how he is feeling.

Princess Charlotte is in the center of attention. She wears a flowered dress. Her hair is in a braid. She looks at the camera. Some comments say she looks just like Catherine. Others think she is more like William. People are happy to see her growing up.

The date of these photos is also discussed. There is no information about when they were taken. Some suggest last month. Others say the photos are new. A royal spokesperson did not answer questions about the date. People online keep guessing, but nobody knows for sure. This has made some people angry.

Many in Britain believe these photos were sent to answer rumors. In recent weeks, there have been many stories about the royal family. Some stories are about Catherine’s health. Others are about family problems. These photos may try to show that the family is together. Some people think it is a message for the British public. They want to say, “do not worry.”

People also talk about who took the photos. The royal family sometimes uses professional photographers. Other times, family members take pictures. In this case, the style looks very simple. Some believe Catherine took the photos herself. Others think it was a friend. A few people say the photos look too professional for a family member. Nobody knows the truth.

The photos are not official portraits. They are more relaxed. Some royal fans like this style. They say the family is trying to be more friendly. Others do not like it. They say the royal family must look more serious. There is much debate in the newspapers and online.

A big question is why Prince George and Prince Louis are missing. Some think they were in school. Others wonder if there is a family problem. The royal spokesperson did not give any answer. People keep asking. The newspapers write about it every day. Even TV shows talk about the missing princes.

British tradition says royal family photos are important. Some holidays, like Christmas or birthdays, always have a new photo. Many people wait for these moments. This time, the photos come at a strange moment. There is no holiday now. Some people are confused. Others hope for more photos soon.

Some people say these photos give hope. The royal family is still together. The pictures show smiles. Children grow up. Parents stand close. There are flowers in the garden. The weather is cloudy but not dark. This gives people a good feeling.

Yet, there are also questions and doubts. Some say the photos hide problems. They say the royal family wants to control the story. Others say it is not important. They only look at the pictures and say the family looks nice.

In the end, the British people discuss these photos in many ways. Some see new details every day. Others wait for the next pictures. There are many ideas, but not many answers. Still, the photos are everywhere. People keep looking. The royal family is still in the news.

Some avoided these topics and spoke only about football.

Last Sunday, a crowd gathered in the city center under gray clouds. Many came to hear speeches about the current president. The main topic was if he is racist. Signs of all colors showed up, some for him, some against him. It was noisy. Many shouted at each other. The police watched but did not go into the crowd.

James Johnson, a speaker at the event, said, “White and black, both feel angry. We need peace but get more fighting.” He says he is tired of talking about racism every week. His cousin, Clara, stood next to him. She said she felt unsafe now. “People look at me strange in some places,” she said. “I never noticed it before the last election.”

The president was not there. His staff said he was working in the White House. A statement from his office said, “The president wants to fight hate and respect everyone. He does not hate people because of their skin.”

Many people still believe he does. Social media fills with stories about him saying rude things. Some old employees say he made jokes about black people. Others call him a friend to all. The press keeps asking about it. The president says, “I am not racist.” But every week, something new happens. The country keeps talking.

The city mayor spoke to reporters. She said, “We see division. It gets worse. Nobody listens.” She blamed both sides for shouting. “People have to speak, yes. On a clear evening at the stadium, Barcelona met Athletic Bilbao in the Copa del Rey final. Many fans waited for this match. They expected excitement. The focus was on Lionel Messi. He is one of the best players in the world. Many hoped he would bring a trophy back to Barcelona.

From the first whistle, both teams tried to take control. Athletic Bilbao pushed forward. They tried to surprise early. Barcelona’s defense stopped most of their attacks. The midfielders passed the ball between themselves. They waited for space to appear. Bilbao pressed hard. Still, Barcelona kept calm.

In the twentieth minute, Barcelona found a good chance. A fast pass landed at Messi’s feet. He moved quickly towards the goal. Defenders closed in. He turned and shot with his left foot. The ball curved just inside the post. Fans cheered. Some Bilbao fans looked disappointed. It was Messi’s first goal of the night.

After that, the game opened up more. Bilbao started to attack with more players. This made space at the back. Barcelona tried to use this space. In the thirty-fifth minute, another chance arrived for Barcelona. Griezmann passed to Messi. Messi controlled the ball well. He tricked the goalkeeper and scored again. There was much celebration from the Barcelona side.

Halftime came. The score was 2-0 in favor of Barcelona. During the break, both coaches talked to players. Some fans believed the trophy would go to Barcelona. Some hoped for a Bilbao comeback.

The second half began. Bilbao increased their efforts. They did not want to lose without a fight. Their forwards ran at Barcelona’s defenders. There were a few close chances. Ter Stegen, Barcelona’s keeper, made important saves. On the other side, Barcelona waited for mistakes. In the sixty-fourth minute, De Jong scored another goal for Barcelona. The players hugged each other.

Some had to pay fines.

After the first round, the government offered more loans. The rules changed again. The application forms were different. Some businesses received money. Others did not. There were accusations of unfairness. Some said larger companies got more loan money. Polzin said, “My neighbor’s restaurant never reopened. He didn’t get the help.”

The SBA, or Small Business Administration, said they tried to correct mistakes. But people were upset. On social media, people shared stories of being rejected. CNN published interviews with struggling business owners. Some said they would close for good.

Many businesses had problems with the tax system during this time. Some used PPP money for rent. Others used it for wages. This caused delays or rejections. Polzin said he had to fill out the forms five times before the bank accepted them. He worried that he would not get any help.

Millions of Americans struggle to buy homes. The real estate market shows many differences across groups. For black homebuyers, it can be harder to get a mortgage from banks. Some say credit scores are one problem. Black families often have lower scores because of past events. This affects their chances to become homeowners.

Many first-time buyers want to own property. They look for options in cities and suburbs. Housing prices rise in many places. People wait longer to buy. They save money for a down payment, but sometimes it is not enough. Banks want buyers to have a good credit history. This makes it tough for those who have missed payments years ago.

Studies say black households earn less income than white households. This adds trouble to buying homes. They cannot save as much. Some decide to rent instead. The gap between owners and renters grows larger. Policy experts worry about this situation. They propose programs for lower fees and loans with easier terms. These programs sometimes help, but not everyone qualifies.

Homeownership rates for black Americans stay lower than the national average. In some regions, the numbers are much smaller. Many families face barriers no matter where they live. Lenders can be strict. They check credit scores, past debts, and job history. If buyers cannot show stable work, the loan is denied. Many younger people feel discouraged.

The market changes every year. Some years see fast growth. More people try to buy homes. Other years, prices fall. This affects all buyers, but the impact is more for groups with smaller savings. Black buyers say they need fairer rules. They want banks to consider other factors besides credit scores. Some loan programs do this, but not all banks use them.

Housing agencies notice these problems. They issue reports and statistics. The reports show differences in loan approvals. Black buyers get fewer approvals even when they earn similar wages. The agencies suggest more training for lenders. They also ask for new rules to make loans fair. Changes can be slow.

It is more common in black communities because single incomes are not always enough. Sometimes, buyers need help with paperwork because loan terms are confusing. Many use community organizations for advice.

Real estate agents say the market is competitive. Buyers must act fast. Prices change quickly. In cities, homes cost more than before. Suburbs become popular for those who want more space. Black buyers often look for areas with good schools. They want safe neighborhoods. But these places are expensive.

The government offers grants for first-time buyers. Some grants are given to minorities. They help pay for a down payment. But the grants do not cover all costs. Families still need savings. Experts say more grants are needed. They want banks to accept smaller down payments if buyers have steady jobs. This is not always allowed. Local rules can be strict.

In the southeastern corner of Australia, officials reported 42 new COVID-19 cases on Wednesday morning. Most of these cases concern the state of New South Wales, which now faces the strongest outbreak since the last year. The state government decided to keep the lockdown for another week at least. Many people are not happy with this decision. They are tired from the long period of limitations since June. State Premier Gladys Berejiklian said it is necessary. She explained that these measures are not easy, but they help to keep the numbers from growing very fast.

Shops and cafes in Sydney have been closed. Only essential services are working. Most residents must stay at home except for buying food or work that cannot be done from their house. Schools conduct online classes. Some families find it hard because not all children have fast internet or quiet space. Police check the streets and remind everyone about masks and distance rules.

Health officials continue to trace contacts of the new cases. They believe the Delta variant spreads quickly. There is worry that the outbreak can reach other parts of the country. In some areas of Sydney, more than half of the new infections are people under 35 years old. Vaccination is progressing slowly compared to other countries. Many ask for more vaccine deliveries.

Prime Minister Scott Morrison said the country must stay patient. He promised more support for businesses. The economic loss is already visible. Many small shops say they cannot wait much longer if the lockdown continues. Doctors say the main thing is to protect the health care system. Most hospital beds are still empty, but the number of patients is growing each day. Berejiklian asked everyone to keep following the rules. She also said the state can return to normal faster if people help each other.

David Brooks, a football player from Wales, received many messages of support after it was announced that he has been diagnosed with Hodgkin lymphoma. Brooks plays for Bournemouth, a club in the English Championship. The information became known this week. Brooks, who is 24 years old, has played several times for the Wales national team. Fans, players, and many people from different countries have expressed their sympathy on social media and in interviews.

Brooks said in a statement that he feels lucky because his illness was found early. He thanked the doctors and the medical staff. He also thanked Bournemouth and the Wales football association. He explained that he will begin treatment soon. He hopes that everything will go well. He wrote that he will do his best to return to playing football as soon as possible.

After the news came out, many clubs shared messages of encouragement. Bournemouth wrote that the whole club stands behind David in this hard period. They said that everyone is sending their strength to him and his family. Wales football association also said that they are with him. Teammates and coaches wrote their hope to see Brooks back playing very soon. Some players from other teams in the Championship also posted messages to wish him a speedy recovery.

In the next weeks, Brooks will not play football. His treatment will begin immediately. The doctors said that with early detection, Hodgkin lymphoma has good chances to be cured. Many people in the football community remember other players who also had health problems and returned to play. They believe Brooks will also be strong.

Supporters from Bournemouth and fans from Wales national team said that they are planning to show banners and wear shirts with messages for Brooks at the next games. They want him to know that he is not alone. On social media, hundreds of people posted comments. Some wrote about their own experiences with similar illnesses. Many said that football is not the most important thing now, but Brooks’s health and recovery.

Brooks’s story has reached many people outside the football world as well. Some local newspapers in Wales and England wrote about the situation. Medical experts explained that Hodgkin lymphoma is a type of cancer that affects the lymph system. They said that young people can recover if treatment begins early. Brooks’s case has helped to make more people aware of the disease.

While Brooks focuses on his health, his teammates said that they will work hard on the field. They want to win matches for him. Coaches told the media that Brooks is a strong person. They believe he will fight and come back soon. For now, everyone waits for good news about his health.

On the island of Samsø, wind is always present. Sometimes it blows strong, sometimes it is only a whisper. For people living here, wind is not only part of daily life. It is also the main provider of energy. The story of Samsø is known in many places. Many speak about how the small island tried, and mostly succeeded, to change how energy is used.

Before, Samsø was like most other places. People heated their homes with oil, cars ran on petrol, and electricity came from far away. Then, about twenty-five years ago, the people of Samsø wanted to try something else. They did not want to be the same as before. They wanted to see if wind and sun could replace oil and coal.

Søren Hermansen is a person who speaks much about this change. He says that the people at first were not sure. Change is often scary. “Many were worried,” Hermansen said. “They thought this would make life more hard, or more expensive. Some did not trust that wind and sun could be enough.”

But there were many meetings. People on the island talked, sometimes for hours. They discussed how the future should look. There was not agreement at the start. Some did not like the tall wind turbines that would be built. Some worried about their view. Some thought about birds. Others just did not like to change the routine.

In time, more people agreed to try. They decided to build several wind turbines. Some would be on land, some would stand in the sea near the coast. With money from both the island and the government, the first turbines began to spin. People could see the blades slicing the air. Children pointed and talked about them.

After some years, Samsø had so many wind turbines that the island produced more electricity than it used. The people said this was a surprise. Many thought it would not work so well. But the numbers were clear. There was enough wind power to send extra electricity to the main part of Denmark.

The change did not stop with turbines. Hermansen and others suggested new heating systems. They built heating plants that use straw from local farms. Instead of oil, houses now get heat from burning straw, or from the sun. Some homes have solar panels. Others use small electric heaters, powered by wind.

The result is that energy on Samsø comes mostly from local sources. The island almost does not use fossil fuel anymore. Only cars and some machines still need petrol or diesel. But even this is changing. Hermansen says more people now drive electric cars. The island has some charging stations, but not enough. “It is still a problem,” he says. “For some jobs you need a van or a tractor. Electric is not always possible.”

The change on Samsø brought attention from other places. People came from different countries to look. They ask how the islanders managed to agree. Hermansen says it was not easy. “Every person had their own idea,” he said. “You must listen. You must be patient. Most important is that people feel it is their project.”

Wind energy shapes life in many small ways. Some days, the wind is too strong and the turbines have to slow down. Other days, there is little wind and electricity comes from batteries or from the straw plant. People say they have learned to live with changes in weather and energy.

Climate is a big topic everywhere now. Hermansen is often invited to speak. He tells how Samsø became nearly carbon-neutral. He says that it is possible even for small places. “If a small island can do it, then others can too,” he says.

Not all is easy. Some on the island say the work is not finished. While electricity is nearly all green, transport is still behind. Boats and some vehicles are still using diesel. A few farmers want to keep their old equipment. Change is slow in some parts.

There is also the cost. At first, many worried that green energy would be more expensive. In the early years, the wind turbines were costly. Now, Hermansen says, costs are more stable. People pay less for heat, sometimes less for electricity. The price goes up and down with the weather, but overall it is better than before.

Children in the school learn about energy from a young age. They visit the wind turbines and see how they work. Some students come from other places for special classes. A teacher said, “It is normal for our children. They grow up with wind and solar.” For them, renewable energy is not strange.

Tourists also visit Samsø because of the energy story. Some ride bicycles to look at the turbines. Many take photos. The local shops sell T-shirts and mugs with windmill pictures. For some, the change has helped the local economy.

There have been some problems. A few times, the wind turbines stopped working in bad weather. The island had to use backup

In a small community situated near the northern border, women have gathered to provide support for refugees arriving from the east. According to local leader Miriam Giddens, the group formed after families noticed new people coming daily. "We wanted to help them feel safe," said Giddens during a meeting on Thursday. The group now has twelve women involved.

The support they offer is direct. Giddens explained, "We bring food and blankets. Some of the refugees need shoes, and many children are cold." The women collect items from neighbors and friends. Then, they bring these things to the place where new arrivals stay. It is an old building near the market where local trading occurs.

Anna Vickery is one of the women giving her time. "I see their faces, and I remember when my family moved here after the flood. It is difficult to have nothing," Vickery said. She explained that the refugees often do not speak the local language. Communication happens with hands and with pointing. Sometimes, a few children translate simple words. "We smile at each other. We try to show we care," Vickery said.

According to the mayor’s office, there are about seventy refugees in the area now. The office gives small help, but it is not enough. Many refugees left all their things behind. Some escaped fighting, and others say they ran from hunger. The women try to listen to their stories, but they do not ask too many questions. Giddens said, "We want them to rest. We do not need to know everything."

The refugee building has no real beds. There are mattresses on the floor, and thin pillows. Vickery described that some families sleep together in small spaces. People wait in the cold air because the rooms are not warm enough. The women's group brought a heater, but it works only in one room.

Trading has changed as well. Local sellers see new faces every day. Goods like potatoes and eggs are now more expensive. "I do not blame the refugees," a market seller said. "Everyone needs to eat. We just have to share what we have." The women’s group tries to arrange extra vegetables and keeps a list of families with special needs.

Some in the town said they are worried about the changes. Giddens asked people to be calm. "We can help if we do not turn away," she said. She believes friendship is the best answer.

Volunteers plan to collect more items this weekend. They hope to make the rooms warmer and the children happier. Vickery said the group will continue as long as there is need. She added, "We are not different, only lucky. Next time, we could be the ones needing help."

The mayor thanked the group in a short letter posted in the main square. It reads, "The town is thankful for every act of help, small or big. We welcome those who come in peace." Giddens said the women feel proud, but also wish for better days for everyone.

A new discovery about ancient disease in humans was announced last week. Some scientists in Europe found bones from a man who lived thousands of years ago. They said this man had a disease that is now not common. The bones were uncovered in a cave in Southern Germany. The researchers explained that the skeleton is very old, from a period when Neanderthals and modern humans lived near each other. This makes the finding special.

The leader of the research team, Dr. Haeusler, spoke to the press. He said the disease was found through careful looking at the skeleton. The man had bone growths that do not form in healthy bodies. These growths are similar to problems seen in old animals and humans today. The scientists think the man had a long-term sickness that affected his movement. He could have struggled to walk or move his arms easily.

The disease is sometimes found in animals. For example, elephants and some big cats can show the same kind of bone change. The scientists were surprised to see it in such an old human. There are very few skeletons from this time that carry signs of disease. This may mean that these ancient people did not live long lives. It is also possible that the healthy ones were more likely to survive and be buried in safe places.

The researchers said the disease could be related to how people lived then. They hunted large animals and ate meat. This might have made them more exposed to sickness from animals. Also, the food was sometimes not cooked enough. This could have helped diseases to move between animals and people. Dr. Haeusler said that they cannot know exactly how the man got sick. The bones only show what happened in his body for the last years of his life.

Neanderthals and early modern humans were different, but they lived close together sometimes. Scientists found that some genes from Neanderthals are still with us today. These genes can help with fighting sickness, but some can also bring problems. The discovery from Germany may help in understanding which diseases were present in the past and how humans got strong against them.

From looking at the skeleton, the team made guesses about the man’s life. He was not very old when he died, maybe around thirty years. The illness made his bones thick and uneven. It did not kill him quickly. The scientists think he suffered from pain for many years. It was a slow disease.

Inside the cave, the bones were found with some stone tools. This can mean that the man was still working and living with others until late in his life. In early human groups, sick people were sometimes cared for by the healthy. There are other places where skeletons with injuries show signs of healing. This means that the group did not leave their weak members alone.

Many questions remain open about the disease. The researchers are not sure if it came from eating sick animals, or if it happened from some other problem. They want to compare this skeleton with others found in Europe and Asia. If more old bones show the same signs, then the disease could have been common. But if not, the case from Germany may be rare.

Dr. Haeusler said that finding disease in old bones is difficult work. Bones must be in good condition to see the changes. In some places, wet soil destroys the skeletons. Also, not every disease leaves a mark on bone. Only the ones that last long time or change the shape will show up. The scientists hope that with better tools, more discoveries will be possible.

This finding is important for science. It helps researchers know more about daily life in very old times. People living then faced many dangers, not only from animals and weather, but also from sickness. The study of the bones from Germany will continue. The team will try to learn more by testing the material with new machines. They also plan to visit other caves in the area.

The scientists said they will share more information later this year. For now, the main lesson is that ancient humans were not so different from us. Disease was there, just like today. The study reminds us that people have always needed to face sickness and survive, even thousands of years ago.

The remnants of hurricane Ida crossed many states in the beginning days of September, leaving damage and confusion behind. The storm first struck as a hurricane, making landfall on the coast. Then it moved inland, losing speed but carrying a lot of rain. In many areas, heavy rain caused rivers to overflow. Streets flooded quickly. Water entered homes and shops. People were left with only the belongings they could carry. Some families left through windows. Many had to wait for rescue.

Photos from the disaster show streets turned into rivers, cars floating or overturned. People are seen on rooftops shouting for help. In some towns, even first responders had trouble reaching trapped people. The water rose fast. Many did not expect such flooding because the storm was not a hurricane anymore. The rain lasted for hours, making the situation worse.

By the following morning, several neighborhoods were covered in mud and broken furniture. On the sides of roads, piles of debris grew. The smell was bad. In cities, subways and basements filled completely. Water rushed into underground spaces, damaging electrical systems and elevators. Transit had to stop. Thousands of people missed work. Some businesses stayed closed for days, not able to clean up fast enough.

Rescue teams came from nearby towns to help. They used small boats to move people from flooded houses. Some people refused to leave, wishing to protect their homes. Others left without knowing where they would go next. Community centers and gyms became shelters. Volunteers arrived with blankets, clean water, and food. One woman said she never saw flooding like this before, even though storms happen every year. She lost all her furniture. Her family is safe, but she does not know how they will start again.

The storm moved north and east. It stopped being a hurricane, but still caused destruction. In some places, the rain hit hardest at night. Some residents woke up when water started pouring into bedrooms. One man went to sleep on dry ground but woke up standing in water. He could not believe it. Reports said more than a dozen people drowned in their own homes. Some apartments were in basement levels with no escape route. Most victims did not realize the risk until it was too late.

Roads and highways were also affected. The rain fell so heavily that drainage systems could not keep up. Water covered highways, causing car accidents and long delays. Emergency workers put up barriers, but some drivers tried to pass them. This often led to dangerous situations. Many cars were lost to the floodwaters. Some drivers had to climb onto their vehicles and wait for help.

Photographers traveled through the storm-affected areas to document the damage. Their photos show people climbing out of windows, walking through waist-deep water, and carrying pets and children. In one photo, a fireman helps a child wearing only pajamas. Another photo shows people sitting on the roof of a bus stop, waiting for rescue. Some photos show the inside of flooded apartments, with personal belongings floating next to chairs and refrigerators.

After the rain, repair crews began to assess the damage. City officials reported broken water lines and damaged power stations. Repairing all systems would take weeks. Some neighborhoods had no clean water. Others were told to boil water before drinking. Electricity was out in many places. Crews worked all day and night to fix the lines. In some areas, fallen trees blocked access to homes and schools. Workers used saws to clear the roads, then power companies fixed the lines.

Insurance companies received thousands of requests. Many people will have to wait a long time for payment. Some lost important papers, making the process harder. Others did not have flood insurance, thinking they would never need it. Now they must pay for repairs by themselves. Local governments offered some help, but the need was greater than the available funds. Charities stepped in to help fill the gaps. Donations came from nearby towns and across the country.

In the days after the disaster, people began to clean up. The mud was sticky and filled with broken glass and sharp metal. It was dangerous to walk without boots. Some people wore masks to protect themselves from dust and mold. Many worried about sickness. Clean-up teams passed out cleaning supplies. Medical staff visited the shelters to check on elderly people and children. Some were suffering from stress or minor injuries.

Counselors helped people deal with the shock. One man, who lost his home, said he could not sleep at night. He worried that rain would come again and flood everything. Children in shelters played with donated toys. Their parents tried to keep them calm. Schools stayed closed in flooded districts. Teachers encouraged students to write about their experiences as a way to process the event.

A group of researchers have reported they found a native mouse in Australia that was believed to be extinct. The team made the announcement after several months of field studies in the western part of the country. Many people had thought the species was lost forever. This mouse, which has small size and brown fur, was last officially seen decades ago.

The researchers explained that the animal was first noticed by chance. A camera trap placed on a remote property recorded the mouse moving at night. After seeing this, the team set more traps and cameras in nearby locations. They succeeded in capturing a few individuals alive. They studied these animals at their base. The experts checked their fur, shape, and differences from other local mice.

They compared the new mice to museum specimens. They also used genetic tests. The tests confirmed that the captured animals are the same species as the extinct one. Some team members described their surprise. It was not only unexpected. It also brings new hope for other lost species. The study leader said they must continue to protect these mice.

This mouse used to be common in several parts of Australia. Farmers and city growth destroyed much of its home over the past century. Cats and foxes also killed many mice. These problems made the mouse population drop quickly. By the 1990s, no one saw this animal any more in the wild. Experts added its name to the extinction list. People talked about it in books and research papers as an example of lost Australian animals.

The recent discovery means the story is not finished. Conservation groups have asked for new rules to save the places where the mouse lives. Local residents near the study area gave some help to the research team. They reported seeing small brown mice sometimes, but were not sure what kind. Now, the scientists want to check other old records and listen to more local stories.

The team has warned that more work is needed. The number of mice found is still very small. Their future still faces many dangers, especially from animals that hunt them and from fires. The researchers hope that their finding will help other efforts to protect native species in Australia. They have shared their results with government bodies and wildlife groups. Some officials are already talking about new actions to support the survival of this mouse.

The study has been published in a scientific journal. It includes photos and data on the mouse’s behavior and food. The researchers want to visit more possible habitats soon. They say anyone who notices similar mice should report it. They hope the news will make people more interested in saving Australia’s unique wildlife.

In the last week, many people who are seeking loans have found that credit scores are causing confusion. A man who wanted to buy a house explained his situation. He said his score was not high enough for the mortgage company. He spoke about feeling frustrated. He wondered why one number can decide such an important outcome.

Another person also shared his experience. He tried to apply for a loan to buy a car. When he checked his credit, he found three different scores from three different agencies. None matched the numbers given by the bank. He said he didn’t know which score mattered. It was not easy for him to understand what happened.

There are many people who find the credit score system confusing. The system relies on complex calculations that most people cannot understand easily. One bank employee explained that scores depend on payment history, debt amounts, and other things. She said customers ask why scores are different in every place. She said banks do not give clear answers. It makes people feel uncertain.

Many mortgage companies have strict rules about scores. They want customers to have higher numbers. One company said they require a score of at least 700 for best rates. If the score is lower, the interest rate goes up. A woman who wanted to buy a house said she had no missed payments, but her score was still low. She said she felt unfairly judged.

Some experts say scores are not perfect. They point out that scores can change quickly. If one person misses one payment by accident, the score will drop. Sometimes scores are not accurate. Errors can happen in reports. One expert said mistakes are common. He advised people to check their reports often.

People who borrow money find more problems. If their scores are low, banks may refuse to lend. Sometimes banks agree to give loans, but the rates are less good. One man said he accepted a loan with high interest. He hoped to pay it off fast, but he worried that his score would not improve. He said he felt trapped.

There are new rules coming. Some governments want to change how scores are made. They think the system should be easier to understand. They want banks to explain to customers what affects scores. One official said people have a right to know. He said rules will make companies share more information.

Not everyone agrees with changes. Some loan companies say scores help them judge risk. If customers know too much about the system, they may try to trick it. One manager said it is better for companies to keep some secrets. He said lending is safer that way. Some people say this attitude is not fair.

There are other problems with credit scores. For some people, the numbers are low for reasons they cannot control. If someone never had a loan before, the score is low. If someone moves to another country, the score does not follow. Young people say the system does not help them start. One student said he could not get a card from the bank. He felt he had to wait many years.

Some data from banks show more people are asking for help. They want to improve their scores. Many banks offer advice, but it is not always useful. Some banks tell people to pay bills on time. Others say to reduce debts. One banker said advice is often too simple. He said people need more support.

Some community groups are trying to help. They teach people how to read reports. They explain how scores work. One volunteer said she meets people every week. She said many people do not know their score until they are refused credit. She said the system is not friendly.

Technology is used by some companies to check scores faster. They use computers to look at reports. Sometimes mistakes are found, but not always fixed. One customer said he saw an error, but the company did not fix it. He had to call many times. He felt tired after each call.

There are stories of people who tried hard to improve their scores. One woman paid all her debts. She waited for her score to rise. She found that after some time, her score still did not go up. She did not understand why. She said banks gave no explanation.

Some people want the system to change. They say one number should not decide everything. They want more ways to show that a person can pay. One idea is to look at rent payments or phone bills. Some countries have tried this. Officials say it helps some people, but not all.

There are many ways people try to avoid problems with scores. Some use cash instead of loans. Others find people to help them co-sign. One man said his father signed for him. He said it helped, but he does not want to rely on others.

Credit scores affect many parts of life. If the score is low, it is harder to buy a house or a car. Some jobs check scores before hiring. One woman said her employer asked for her score. She felt embarrassed. She said she does not know why it is important.

Several countries in Europe are deciding on new measures to slow the latest coronavirus wave. Many of these measures focus on people who are not vaccinated. The governments say it is important to control the new wave before winter comes. Some countries are changing rules because the number of cases is rising fast. Hospitals are starting to prepare for more patients. Experts worry that the health system could be under pressure if the number of new infections keeps going up. The main places with concern are in Central and Eastern Europe, but several Western European countries are also watching the situation closely.

In Germany, leaders are discussing if they should make new restrictions for people who have not received a vaccine. The number of daily infections is higher than before. Health officials warn that the situation is becoming difficult. In Austria, the government has announced stricter controls for the unvaccinated. Only people who are vaccinated or have recovered from Covid-19 can enter restaurants, bars, and other public places. The government of the country says these steps are needed to protect hospitals. Some citizens worry about fairness and personal choice, but many agree that the health system must be protected.

France has increased the pressure on people to get vaccinated. The country already uses a health pass to enter many places like cinemas, museums, and cafes. Authorities now plan to check this health pass more often. The president asks people not to wait for the next wave, but to get vaccinated now. The officials say vaccination rates are high but must go higher to stop a new wave from causing more problems. In Italy, politicians are talking about making vaccines mandatory for more workers. Some people already need a special certificate for work, but there is a discussion about extending this to more groups.

Poland and Slovakia are both seeing increasing numbers of daily cases. Hospitals in these countries are warning about the possibility of more severe cases soon. The government in Poland is asking people to get the vaccine. The authorities say vaccination is free and available for all adults. Still, a large number of people are choosing not to do it. In Slovakia, leaders talk about needing new measures very soon. There is worry that the vaccination rate is still too low to keep the hospitals safe if the wave becomes stronger.

In Hungary, the authorities are now strongly recommending the vaccine. They also ask older citizens to take extra care. In Romania, the medical system is already in a very hard place. The number of deaths is high each day. The health minister says that vaccination is the main solution. He asks all Romanians to trust the new vaccines. The government tries to set up more places for people to get vaccinated easily. Doctors and nurses are working long hours. Some international help has arrived with medical supplies.

The European Union is watching the situation. Officials ask all member countries to do more for vaccination campaigns. The goal is to stop the new wave from becoming even worse. The European health agency warns that the danger is not over. They say that winter can make the virus spread more quickly. Cold weather means people spend more time inside. The agency recommends ventilation and masks in closed places. They stress that vaccines work well against severe cases and death, but countries must act soon.

Some countries started booster campaigns. Older people and those with weak health can get extra vaccine doses. Scientists say this will help to keep protection high. There are discussions about how often boosters are needed. Each country is deciding for itself about this. Some leaders say it is better to act fast. Others worry about public opinion. Still, the wave is forcing quick decisions.

Many citizens in Europe are discussing the new rules. Some people feel the measures are too strong. Others say the rules are not strong enough. Street protests have happened in some cities. Most leaders ask for calm and patience. They say the vaccine is the key to a normal life. They repeat that more vaccination will stop new measures. The approach is different in each country. But the hope is the same. Leaders want to end the wave and prevent new ones.

Experts say the situation changes fast. New variants could appear and make the situation harder. The World Health Organization asks for global cooperation. They point out that the pandemic is still present everywhere. European countries now watch each other. They hope that with more vaccination and some new measures, the health system will not break. Winter is coming soon. All countries want to avoid a repeat of last year. The next few weeks will be important for Europe.

Liverpool won against Manchester City and now stands higher in the league. The match took place at the city's home ground. The Liverpool side played in a way that seemed very organized. The team moved together and covered each other. Klopp, the manager, stood at the touchline and gave many instructions. He was seen shouting and pointing often. The players appeared to respond. Several times they changed positions. The city side tried to play fast but Liverpool blocked most attacks.

It became clear early that Liverpool wanted to press high. Klopp told players to stay close to the city midfield. When city tried to move the ball forward, Liverpool defenders stepped up. The first goal came after a mistake from the city goalkeeper. He passed to a defender who was under pressure. The Liverpool forward took the ball and scored. The city players showed frustration. Some argued about who should have been covering.

After the goal, the atmosphere changed. The home crowd became quiet. Liverpool played more calmly. They moved the ball from side to side. City tried to react but failed to connect passes. Klopp kept watching the city bench. He noticed Guardiola speaking to his staff. City then made a substitution. A new player came on to try to help in attack. He ran a lot and received several passes, but could not break through Liverpool's defence.

Half time arrived with only one goal. Players walked off without much talking. Liverpool looked happier. City seemed tired and unsure. Klopp spoke to his captain before they returned for the second half. He explained something with his hands. The second half started with city trying to push forward immediately. Liverpool stood strong. The defenders won many headers and tackles. Klopp shouted instructions to make the team keep their compact shape. City had a few chances but could not hit the target.

Around the hour mark, Liverpool attacked again. This time, after winning a corner, the ball was played into the box. Several players jumped. A Liverpool midfielder touched the ball and sent it past the goalkeeper. The city fans groaned. Klopp clapped his hands and patted the scorer on the back. The city side looked disappointed. They moved slower and did not seem to believe they could come back.

In the last minutes, city tried long balls. Liverpool cleared them away. Klopp made substitutions to defend the lead. He put on fresh players who kept running. City had one last chance when a striker ran through and shot, but the Liverpool goalkeeper saved easily. After the final whistle, Liverpool players hugged each other. Klopp walked on the field and spoke to each player. The city side walked off with their heads down. Guardiola did not speak much. The Liverpool fans cheered loudly and sang songs.

Liverpool’s win means they are now closer to the top of the league. Klopp said after the match that his team played really well. He was happy with their effort. City side players did not say much in interviews. The league table changed and Liverpool is now two points ahead. Fans hope the team will keep playing this way. Klopp asked for calm and focus for the next matches. The city set will try to recover in their next game. The league remains close. Every match is important now. The Liverpool side will prepare for their next opponent, hoping to play really well again.

Numbers have always fascinated me. When I was in the second grade, I won a small quiz for naming the first ten prime numbers in order. For some reason, that memory stuck with me. Figures and their uses seem to pop up everywhere you look these days. Just scroll through any website, and you’ll see statistics, rankings, percentages, and strangely specific year-over-year charts. Why do we focus so much on numbers? Maybe it's because they give us the illusion of certainty. Or maybe we’re just addicted to measuring things.

Last year, a friend showed me a website that tracks the popularity of every possible baby name. Each name had a number next to it. I typed in mine. It wasn’t even close to popular. That stung a little, though I don’t know why. But data like that is everywhere. Second place isn’t the same as first, and some numbers feel heavier than others, even when the difference is small. Sometimes I wonder how much trust we should place in all these figures. Does a website score really tell you what’s best? Or is it just another number in an endless list, shifting a little each year as people click, search, and move on? The numbers keep climbing, falling, changing. But the stories behind them, those we rarely see.
